_meta.note: Walking-logic extracted from fandom route text + annotated images. Tibia 7.4 vanilla; verify on Rivalia. This route is a HUB overview (routes around/through/into Kazordoon), not a single A→B corridor — steps cover the entrance descent, the surface city connections, and the Dwarf Mine exit.
_meta.coord_system: Tibia game coords. z = floor (7=ground, higher=deeper). down = descend one floor (ladder/hole/rope-spot).
_meta.legend: steps[] is an ordered walking sequence. Each step: floor, cardinal heading, action, hazards, and floor transition. Kazordoon is inside a mountain, entered from the surface and traversed via mine tunnels.

route: Kazordoon (routes around / through / into the mountain city)
from: Surface north of Dwarven Bridge (Kazordoon mountain, central Tibia)
to: Kazordoon city / Dwarf Mines (and onward connections to Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Thais, Venore)

start.note: Kazordoon entrance on the mountain surface — exact coords not given in source

min_level_note: Text: face Poison Spiders, Spiders, Rotworms, Wolves, Dwarfs, and a Dwarf Soldier on the Dwarf Bridge. Rope + Shovel required.

steps.heading: N
steps.text: Approach the Kazordoon entrance on the mountain surface (white line leads up to the marked 'Kazordoon entrance'). Dwarven Bridge lies to the SE.
Enter the entrance and go DOWN into the mountain. Inset (red box) shows the underground passage: descend the marked hole ('Down this hole', dotted yellow line) to move through the tunnel.
Follow the tunnel; at the far end use the 'Rope up' spot (marked A = roping spot) to reach the next connecting level. Beware hidden holes.

CITY CONNECTIONS (surface hub): from the Kazordoon entrance area, white arrows fan out — NW to Carlin, NE to Ab'Dendriel, S to Thais, SE to Venore (via the Dwarf Bridge). Two rope holes and a stairs on the west side link surface levels.
To cross the western gap, take the 'Stairs' down, or use either 'Rope Hole' (two are marked) to shortcut between the upper and lower surface levels.

steps.heading: NW/W
steps.text: DWARF MINE EXIT: from the mines, follow the white arrows NW/W. Use the marked 'Shovel Hole'(s) (dig with shovel) and 'Rope Hole' to change levels; the 'Stairs' (top-right, circled) returns you toward the surface.

HIDDEN-HOLE WARNING: in the mine, A (red circle) = a roping spot you CAN climb back up; B (green/red circle) = a HIDDEN hole you fall through. Do not confuse them — dropping into B is one of the classic Kazordoon traps.
